agenda_text:
City of Encinitas
San Dieguito Water District Special Meeting 4:00 p.m. (Following the 4:00 p.m. SDWD Closed Session)
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, MAY 20, 2015 -
04:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
PRESENTATIONS
Present awards to fourth grade water awareness poster contest winners.
CALL TO ORDER/ROLL CALL
San Dieguito Water District Board Members receive an independent stipend of $100 for convening the Water District meetings pursuant to San Dieguito Water District Resolution No. 89-07.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
AGENDA ITEMS
1.
San Dieguito Water District Fiscal Year 2014/15 3rd Quarter Budget Report. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Umbrasas
1) Receive and file this report; and 2) Approve requests for mid-year budget adjustments as noted in this report.
2015-05-20 SDWD Item S1 - FY 14/15 3rd Quarter Budget Report
2.
Introduction of the FY 2015/16 and FY 2016/17 San Dieguito Water District Operating and Capital Budget. Contact Person: Administrative Services Manager Umbrasas
1) Receive the Draft FY 2015/16 and FY 2016/17 San Dieguito Water District Operating and Capital Budget; 2) Review and discuss the information presented; and 3) Provide direction to staff in anticipation of budget adoption at the June 17, 2015 Board Meeting.
2015-05-20 SDWD Item S2 - Draft FY 15/16 and FY 16/17 SDWD Operating and Capital Budget
3.
San Dieguito Water District drought actions to achieve compliance with the State Water Resources Control Board's Emergency Regulations. Contact Person: General Manager O'Donnell
1) Adopt Resolution No. 2015-06, declaring a Water Supply Shortage Response Level 3 Condition; 2) Approve the implementation of Drought Rates associated with a 14% water demand reduction; and 3) Authorize the General Manager to limit landscape irrigation to two assigned days per week. Alternatives to recommended actions 1 and 2: 1) Remain at a Water Supply Shortage Response Level 2 Condition; and 2) Approve the implementation of Drought Rates associated with a 28% water demand reduction or remain at current non-drought rates.
2015-05-20 SDWD Item S3 - Drought Actions
ADJOURNMENT
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
